title: fix(app-shell): both Duplicate forms judge a package id by the spec's id rule (objectui#11855)
body:
Fixes #11855

Clause-②: no

The Studio landing's *Duplicate* form, and the package sheet's *Duplicate* form that reuses it on purpose, armed their button with a hand-copied regex, `PACKAGE_ID_RE` in `studio-design/packages-io.ts`. It disagreed with the server in both directions: it refused `163.com.crm`, a digit-led segment the spec accepts, and it let `com.acme.my_app`, `com.-x` and `a..b` through to the duplicate route's 400. Its stripped-characters notice also told the author that underscores are allowed. Both forms now judge by the spec's `ManifestSchema.shape.id`, through the same predicate and the same wording as the *New package* dialog (objectui#11792, PR objectui#11853), so the three package-id forms share one rule.

## What changed

- `studio-design/packages-io.ts`: `PACKAGE_ID_RE` is retired. `isSpecPackageId(v)`, which is `ManifestSchema.shape.id.safeParse(v).success`, takes its place. It is moved here out of `PackageFormDialog.tsx`, so one predicate serves the three forms. `sanitizePackageId`'s JSDoc no longer calls a regex the format authority.
- `studio-design/PackageIdInput.tsx`: the default rule is the spec's rule, worded with the `engine.packages.idRule.formatHint` and `engine.packages.idRule.strippedNotice` rows the New package dialog already shows (a module-private `specPackageIdRule(locale)`).
- `studio-design/BuilderLanding.tsx` (`doDup` and the button's armed check) and `metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx` (`dupArmed` and `duplicateApp`) judge by `isSpecPackageId`. Their `PackageIdInput` uses its default rule, so the hint and the button read the same predicate.
- `metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.tsx`: a pure move, with no behaviour change. Its private `isSpecPackageId` is now imported from `packages-io`. Its `idRule` memo and the `rule={idRule}` prop are gone, because the input's default is now the same predicate and the same two strings. Its existing pins pass, including the zh underscore hint in the `idDerive-11792` file.
- `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: the en and zh rows `engine.studio.pkg.idStrippedNotice` and `engine.studio.pkg.idFormatHint` are removed, because nothing reads them after the change. No other row is touched.
- `.changeset/11855-duplicate-id-spec-rule.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

No export of the package entry, no prop, no type member and no `packages/i18n` key changes. Docs: no README or `content/docs` sentence describes the duplicate form's id rule. The app-shell README sentence that the `~org` segment is outside every package-id alphabet stays true.

## Measurements (the dispatch's H1 to H4)

- **H1, one rule.** Installed `@objectstack/spec` is 17.7.0. In its `dist/kernel/index.mjs`, `ManifestSchema`'s `id` is `z.string().regex(MANIFEST_ID_PATTERN, ...)`. `MANIFEST_ID_PATTERN` is `/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*(\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*)+$/`. A node probe over 18 ids found 0 disagreements between the schema and the pattern. I used `ManifestSchema.shape.id`, the declaration both server doors parse with, as objectui#11792 did.
- **H2, as the server answers.** On objectstack `main` `51290bca`, the duplicate door parses `targetPackageId` with `ManifestSchema.shape.id.safeParse` before anything is minted (the block headed "THE TARGET ID IS PARSED BEFORE ANYTHING IS MINTED" in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`). That is read from source, not measured live. The pins render the real `BuilderLanding` and the real `PackageDetailSheet`:
  - `163.com.crm` is armed and posted as typed;
  - `com.acme.my_app`, `com.-x` and `a..b` are refused, with the button disabled, the hint shown, and nothing on the wire from either the button or Enter;
  - controls: `com.example.myapp` is armed, and the prefilled id (the source id with `-copy` appended) is armed without an edit.
  
  Each literal verdict is also asserted against the installed declaration.
- **H3, the sanitizer.** It is unchanged. The New package dialog since objectui#11853 keeps `_` in the field, because the sanitizer's alphabet keeps it. Its rule refuses the id, and its hint says underscores are not allowed. The stripped notice appears only when characters are dropped. Both Duplicate forms now do the same, and that is pinned. Because `sanitizePackageId` is not changed, the New package dialog's behaviour does not change.
- **H4, no other reader.** On base `9cb4e29`, `git grep -l PACKAGE_ID_RE` named 10 files: the four source files on the surface; `PackageFormDialog.tsx` and `studioScope.ts`, in comments; and the four tests `PackageIdInput.test.tsx`, `studioScope.test.ts`, `PackagesPage.confirmFlows-11784.test.tsx` and `PackageFormDialog.idDerive-11792.test.tsx`. On head, `git grep -n PACKAGE_ID_RE` exits 1. The control `git grep -c NAMESPACE_RE` on `packages-io.ts` gives 1. On base the two retired rows appeared in two files: their definitions in `i18n.ts` and the reads in `PackageIdInput.tsx`. On head neither appears anywhere, and the control `engine.studio.pkg.writable` still hits. Every test that pinned the old regex is updated to the spec rule. No test is deleted.

## File surface: amendment requested

Three files outside the claim's surface were edited, all because they read the retired symbol (H4):

1. `studio-design/studioScope.ts`: a comment only. It named `PACKAGE_ID_RE` among the alphabets the `~org` segment is outside of.
2. `studio-design/studioScope.test.ts`: it imported `PACKAGE_ID_RE` for that pin, and now asserts `isSpecPackageId`.
3. `metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.idDerive-11792.test.tsx`: it imported `PACKAGE_ID_RE` for "the probe list really separates the two grammars". It now asserts both directions on the spec rule (`163.com.crm` accepted, `com.acme.my_app` refused) and that both verdicts occur in the list.

`PackageFormDialog.tsx` is the pure move the dispatch allowed. The claim asked for a stop and a report before the PR opened. H4 asks for no remaining reader of a retired symbol. I opened this draft with both stated, so the seat can rule on the amendment.

## Tests and gates (head `0ce828b`)

- Repo-root `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over 37 files. The set is the touched and new tests, every test that imports `packages-io`, `PackageIdInput`, `BuilderLanding`, `PackagesPage` or `PackageFormDialog`, `studio-locale.i18n.test.tsx`, and `column-identity.ratchet.test.ts`. Result: `Test Files  37 passed (37)`, `Tests  332 passed (332)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exits 0. The dependency closure was built first with `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`, which also exits 0. The test program, `tsconfig.test.json`, lists all six touched test files under `--listFilesOnly`.
- **Reverse check:** I committed first. Then I put the base blobs of the six source files back (`packages-io.ts`, `PackageIdInput.tsx`, `BuilderLanding.tsx`, `PackagesPage.tsx`, `PackageFormDialog.tsx` and `i18n.ts`). On-disk blob hashes equalled the base blobs, and `BuilderLanding.tsx` read `PACKAGE_ID_RE` 3 times and `isSpecPackageId` 0 times.
  - The two new files gave `Tests  11 failed | 6 passed (17)`.
  - The failures are `163.com.crm` (expected armed), `com.acme.my_app`, `com.-x` and `a..b` (expected refused), and the shared-wording hint and notice pins, on both forms.
  - The 6 passes are the controls: `com.example.myapp`, the prefilled `-copy` id, and the verdict-versus-declaration check.
  - Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATHS`. All 6 HEAD blob hashes matched, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- Gates, each with its own verdict line:
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (13 source files of 1 released package, 1 changeset);
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`;
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (`VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`);
  - `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims` and `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources`;
  - `pnpm check:i18n-designer-parity` (`Every en row has a zh row`), `pnpm check:i18n-keys` and `pnpm check:i18n-drift` (2 rows removed, 0 en values changed);
  - `pnpm check:spec-symbols`;
  - `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape` and `check-test-path-roots`;
  - `pnpm check:esm-specifiers`, `pnpm check:phantom-deps` and `pnpm check:self-import`.

  All exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 13 touched TS files (`--format json`: 13 files) gives 0 errors and 19 warnings. Those are the same 17 and 2 that the base blobs of `PackagesPage.tsx` and `PackageFormDialog.tsx` carry, so nothing is new. Type-aware linting is not enabled for these files, so this narrowing cannot move any verdict on a file it did not touch. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **Ids the duplicate door refuses after the id gate.** `com.example.x`, `com.acme.123` and `a.b` pass the spec's id rule, and they passed the old regex too, so both Duplicate forms arm for them. On the installed spec, `deriveNamespaceFromPackageId` answers null for each of them. The duplicate door's next step then refuses with "Cannot derive a package namespace", because neither form sends `targetNamespace`. This was read from source plus a node probe, not measured at the door, so it is not filed. Carrier: none.
- **`PackageIdInput`'s optional `rule` prop has no caller left.** It was added so the New package dialog could override the old default. It is a dead prop, not filed. Carrier: none.

Implemented in session `session_01MgfduSkFrfM3eorB3UGfAU` (seat `domain:ui#2`).
